newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police had questioned four Solar Temple victims.
newsitem.headline: Police had questioned four Solar Temple victims.

text.p: Four of the five members of the Solar Temple sect who died in an apparent group suicide in Canada over the weekend had been questioned by police about a previous mass death pact in France, justice sources said on Monday.

The sources said the disciples had been questioned under an international warrant issued last May by Grenoble judge Luc Fontaine, who is investigating the deaths of 16 Solar Temple members in December 1995.
Those questioned were Frenchman Didier Queze, his wife Chantale Goupillot, Swiss Bruno Klauss and his Quebec Canadian companion Pauline Riou.
They told Canadian police that "they no longer had any contact whatever with the members of the sect and that they condemned the massacre of the Solar Temple sect," the sources said.

The four, plus Goupillot's French mother Suzanne Druau, perished on Saturday in a blazing house owned by a member of the doomsday cult in Saint Casimir, a village 37 miles (60 km) southwest of Quebec City.
Police said the deaths appeared to be a suicide pact..

"All the people heard by the magistrate stated that they no longer had anything to do with the Solar Temple Order. But some of their answers showed that they are still under its influence," lawyer Joelle Vernay, who represents civil plaintiffs in the December 1995 deaths, told Reuters told Reuters.
"They are fragile and vulnerable people who risk dying at any time. The authorities must set up a strict surveillance system of these people," she said.

The Order of the Solar Temple received worldwide attention in October 1994 when 53 of its members died in a mixture of murder and suicide in two Swiss villages in the cantons of Fribourg and Valais and a ski resort in Quebec.

A year later, in December 1995, 16 cult members including several children died in a remote French Alpine forest clearing. Most of them were drugged and had plastic bags pulled over their heads before they were shot.
